claims.claim: No common adverse issue found across Maybank, CIMB and Bangkok Bank for 17–24 Sep 2026
claims.reason: No cited source shows a shared adverse issue at these three banks in the window. S1 (23 Sep) mentions Maybank and CIMB only in a positive context: tokenisation pilots in BNM's Digital Asset Innovation Hub. S2 was published 30 Sep, after the window and the run date, so it cannot contradict a claim about 17–24 Sep.

claims.claim: Thai flood relief measures came after the window
claims.reason: The only source for this is S2, published 2026-09-30, which is after the 2026-09-24 run date. S2 also never says when the relief measures were introduced. It only says banks introduced them 'in response to the recent flooding', so their timing relative to 17–24 Sep cannot be confirmed.
